g.text: First split: the search settles in one dip; the proven best is in another

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa4ae

g.text: Good qubit energies come in separate dips (the README's 'peaks'), centred near 2π divided by a zero of the Bessel function J1 (dotted lines).

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa4ae

g.text: Grey: the selection ratio of each of their 15,001 fits. Blue: the certified best inside each dip. Lower is better.
